title: Zelensky asked to attend Trump's inauguration three times and was rejected
text: EUvsDisinfo – przypadek dezinformacji: Zelensky asked to attend Trump's inauguration three times and was rejected. SUMMARY Trump did not hide during the election campaign that he intended to change Washington's policy towards Kyiv, that he was against sending weapons worth tens of billions of dollars to Kyiv. Well, here is one of the proofs of this: Trump did not invite Zelenskyy to his inauguration, although it is interesting that Zelenskyy himself said that he did not go to Washington only because he had a lot of important things to do at home. But as one of Trump's sons, Donald Jr., recently reported, Zelenskyy actually asked to attend the inauguration three times, but never received an official invitation. RESPONSE
